name: The Nine Elders of the Mountain of Fragrance

summary: The Nine Elders of the Mountain of Fragrance (香山九老圖), 1426–52. Attributed to Xie Huan (Chinese, c. 1370-c.1450). Handscroll, ink and color on silk; painting: 29.4 x 148.9 cm (11 9/16 x 58 5/8 in.). The Cleveland Museum of Art, Bequest of Mrs. A. Dean Perry, 1997.99
